outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your practice pages
outreach_draft.body:
Brad,

I noticed the site puts DWI, traffic violations and more serious felony/misdemeanor matters into the same main practice experience.

They all fall within criminal and traffic defense, but the people arriving for them are often trying to understand very different things. Someone facing a DWI has immediate license and timing concerns that are different from a routine traffic-ticket client or someone charged with a serious felony.

Dedicated pages for those main matters could:
- speak directly to that type of client
- give Google a focused page to crawl and index
- give AI tools clearer context about each part of the practice

I’m using DWI as the first mockup example because it makes that difference especially easy to show.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
